notes: Country determination: Germany (Hamburg), certainty high - license plate 'HH FV 296' on trailer (photo 1), German plan text 'ANSICHT von der STRASSE / vom GARTEN / GIEBELANSICHT', Baubehoerde Hamburg stamp dated 12.1.79, street name 'Braamheide' (Hamburg). Calc profile DE.
All three plan sheets are scanned rotated 90 degrees (title text vertical); drawings interpreted after mental rotation.

Elevation naming is functional per triage: front = gable end with entry door/porch (photos 1, 6), back = gable end with balcony and PV (photos 3, 4), right = eave side with round window (photo 2), left = eave side with shed dormer (photo 5). The 1979 plan's 'Ansicht von der Strasse' shows an EAVE side, i.e. the historical street orientation differs from the triage naming; naming kept functional per photos.

Brick facade: slim yellow facing bricks, format ambiguous - most consistent with DF raster (course incl. joint 62.5 mm), NF (83.3 mm) not fully excluded; coursing down-weighted to medium/low accordingly.
Entry door anchor: 1985 mm assumed (house built ~1960s-70s per plan set approved 1979; door proportions in photo 1 match ~2.0 m, not 2110).
PV modules (modern 1722 x 1134 mm, standardized) on the back gable and balcony railing are the strongest photo references and confirm the plan-derived gable width of 11194 mm within 3%.
Facade corner of photo 4 lies close to the image edges; minor wide-angle compression possible on the width chains from photo 4.
Glass-block infill wall at the entry porch (photos 1, 6) is part of porch attachment AT-4, not counted as an opening.

warnings: Axis assignment: the only plan dimension chain (page 3, total 11.194 m) sits on the Giebelansicht sheet and is assigned to the GABLE facade width (front/back per functional naming) = footprint.width_mm; PV-module photo chains (10.89-11.15 m) confirm this within 3%. The eave-side axis (footprint depth) has NO plan chain and is photo-estimated only.
Depth basis: left/right elevations are only available in oblique photos (2, 5); footprint depth confidence capped at low - no frontal side view.

Plan vs. photo: 1979 plan street/garden (eave-side) elevations show a different window layout, TWO chimneys and two small roof openings (skylights); photos show one chimney, a large shed dormer on the left roof face, an awning and changed openings. Photos win on existence/count; plan skylights omitted as not confirmable as-built.

Plan vs. photo: plan elevations carry no written dimensions (pages 1-2); only page 3 chain used. Page 3 row 4 chain is partially illegible (first value cut off): transcribed sum 8734 mm vs total 11194 mm.
Openings likely undercounted on right elevation: base zone ~15-20% occluded by waste containers and stored pavers (photo 2); additional basement windows possible.
Openings likely undercounted on front: lower-right zone occluded by trailer and carport contents (photos 1, 6).
Brick format ambiguous (slim yellow bricks, DF 62.5 mm assumed, NF 83.3 mm possible); coursing chains down-weighted, kept alongside door- and PV-based chains per reference disagreement rule.
Ridge height derived from upward-looking photos with large extrapolation above reference objects - confidence low.
Ground line partially occluded/regraded on left and back elevations (excavation works); grade zero taken at street-side grade, heights capped at medium.
Back OG openings W-5/W-6: one of them may be a balcony access door (bottoms partly hidden behind railing PV modules); both modeled as windows.
W-17 sits in the dormer face; a dedicated dormer wall face WL-5 was created as its parent.
Detached outbuilding AT-6 (photo 6, right edge) only partially visible - dimensions null.
